notes: The street east of Main is printed 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)' (plain 'WOODWARD' on 146; on 152 the next street north is 'WOODWARD (FRANKLIN)'), so it is named East 13th Street; East 13th west of Main (sheet 146) meets Main ~140 px further north (first entry), giving two East 13th T points on Main. East 12th Street meets Main twice: the segment east of Main at y~1884, and the segment from the west (sheet 146) at y~2402, where an unnamed 10 ft alley continues east to Sycamore ~9 px further south (listed under alleys). The 10 ft alley north of 12th (East 13th to 12th, label just 'ALLEY') is in line with Long Alley south of 12th and with Long Alley on sheet 152, so it is named Long Alley and Long Alley/12th is a cross. The unnamed 12 ft alley from East 13th to 12th at x~2450 is in line with Cogswell Alley on sheet 152 and is named so (it is not labelled on this sheet). Cassatt Alley crosses both unnamed north-south alleys; E. Central Parkway is printed over the canal; points are on the north canal-bank street (E.N. Canal) centreline; it ends at Sycamore because the block east of Sycamore runs to the canal edge. No south bank street or south blocks are drawn on this sheet. The unnamed 10 ft E-W alley from Main (continuing the line of East 12th from sheet 146) to Sycamore at y~2411 is listed under alleys only (unnamed alleys are not given intersection points); Long Alley crosses it at ~(1752,2411) and County Alley starts from it at ~(2452,2412).
